title: Pick the fix
brief:
The `fix` branch has two commits: "fix the crash" (gold) and "debug logging" (junk you never want on main). Merging would take both. You need exactly one commit's change copied onto main.

`git cherry-pick <commit>` computes what that commit changed relative to its parent and replays it onto where you stand. A copy, with a new SHA: the original stays on its branch.

Cherry-pick the crash fix onto main. The fix branch's tip is the junk commit; the one you want is right below it: `fix~1`.

goals.label: The crash fix is on main
Only the fix came over (no junk, no merge commit)

hints: Stay on main. The target commit is fix~1 (one below the fix tip).
Merging fix would fast-forward main to the junk commit. Cherry-pick names exactly the change you want: base-to-theirs is the commit's own diff.
